messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV=pg1 runtime-engine crashloop detected on host-inf-gpu-3. 5 restarts in 2m. Reason: segfault (SIGSEGV) in runtime-engine process. Affected pods: runtime-engine-*** (node host-inf-gpu-3). Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/runtime-crashloop. Paging: @Maya Patel (oncall).

Maya Patel: Oncall Maya here, jumping in. Acknowledge page. Starting triage — collecting pod logs and node status.

Devon Chu: Copy. Quick glance at k8s:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n redwood | grep runtime-engine
runtime-engine-5f9d7   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   4   3m
runtime-engine-7b2c1   1/1   Running            0   10m
```
The crashloop is concentrated on the pod scheduled to host-inf-gpu-3.

Devon Chu: Pod logs (tail):
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:01Z] runtime-engine[12345]: loading fused_kernel.so
[2026-03-15T14:12:02Z] runtime-engine[12345]: allocate_kv_cache: 0x7f9a2bfc0000
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] runtime-engine[12345]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f9c1d2f1b3f sp 00007ffcf2d5b9c0 error 4 in fused_kernel.so[7f9c1d1f0000+12000]
```
This looks like a native crash inside the fused kernel. :grimacing:

Priya Singh: I pulled dmesg from the node, there's an oops followed by a GPU driver complaint: "NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus" and then a SIGSEGV in module fused_kernel. Node shows memory pressure around the time of crash.

Priya Singh: `kubectl describe node host-inf-gpu-3` snippet:
```
Conditions:
  MemoryPressure   True  2m
  DiskPressure     False
  PIDPressure      False
Allocated resources:  GPUs=1/1, CPU=96%, Memory=84%
```
Suggest cordoning node and moving remaining runtime-engine pods off before replacing.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) cordon host-inf-gpu-3 2) drain runtime-engine pods (force if needed) 3) scale down model-heavy routes to reduce new allocations 4) failover traffic to runtime-engine-7b2c1 (other node). Executing now.

Maya Patel: `kubectl cordon host-inf-gpu-3` -> Done. Starting drain: `kubectl drain host-inf-gpu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (evicting pods).

ops-bot: Deployment runtime-engine rollback triggered: runtime-engine:v2.6 -> runtime-engine:v2.5 by @Lukas Weber for rapid mitigation. New replicas coming up.

Lukas Weber: Noticed we merged a kernel-binding bump earlier today (PR #4123) that loads fused_kernel v1.4. Rolling back to v1.3 as quick mitigation — it removes the new codepath that looks like the crash site. Rolling now.

Devon Chu: After rollback, pods on healthy nodes are stable. Crashlooping pod remains on cordoned host (evicted). New pods scheduled to other GPU hosts and are coming up:
```
runtime-engine-8d3a2   1/1   Running   0   30s
runtime-engine-9a4b1   1/1   Running   0   28s
```
No new segfaults observed in the last 3 minutes. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Customer impact check: CS has been pinged. Initial telemetry shows increased 5xx for two enterprise customers on dedicated capacity (acct-redwood-corp, acct-dataflow-inc). Errors coincided with crash window (14:11–14:17 UTC). Estimated request failure rate ~3–7% for those customers, some request timeouts. Not a global outage but high impact for those tenants.

Priya Singh: Node kernel logs preserved and I took a snapshot for SRE postmortem. Evidence points to a null pointer deref in fused_kernel when the driver reported a GPU fault; likely race between GPU reset and module call. We'll hand this to runtime/ML infra to dig deeper.

Maya Patel: Short-term resolution: rollback applied, node cordoned, workloads drained and rescheduled, affected customers are failing over to other hosts. Incident classified as PG1 (partial customer impact). Initiating incident bridge for handoff and longer investigation.

ops-oncall: Created incident ticket INC-20260315-4829 and linked to pager history. Notifying Account teams for affected customers and opening high-priority support tickets.

Lukas Weber: Next actions for eng: 1) reproduce locally with fused_kernel v1.4 + GPU repro script, 2) add safety checks in kernel call path, 3) add extra logging around allocation/free sequences, 4) ensure graceful fallback to CPU when GPU falls off bus.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. I'll stay on the bridge for 30m to confirm stability, then hand off to Lukas for root cause. Please drop any logs or repro steps into INC-20260315-4829. We'll schedule a postmortem within 48h. :white_check_mark:

Devon Chu: One more note — turning on node-level auto-replace for host-inf-gpu-3 to avoid manual reprovisioning for now.

Maya Patel: Closing page for now; continuing to monitor. If any regression appears re-open page. End of thread.
